"Current Episode" and "Choose a different episode" are not on the same baseline: the latter is too low. Also the latter is not the same color; please ensure they're on the same baseline and are the same color. 

I think you should also be tabbing in the two bits of text a bit more on the unhovered pane ("Current Episode" and "A pair of Russian ...", in this case), because when you do the hover and these assets go inside a rounded-corner card, the left margin seems too small.

Consider adding some sort of icon indicator for an episode to take the place occupied by the left arrow in the hovered version. Maybe a softly pulsing gold dot (almost to symbolize live television?); i'm mot sure.

I am going to keep leaving camera angles I like, so you can learn better.

Please use machine learning to learn my favorite angles and develop a certain animation scheme to always hit them.

You know, another strategy here might be for you to just create a checklist for me: showing every permutation of all the toggles (which satellite in the drop down we’re looking at, which satellite is centered in the relative motion frame, what chapter we’re in, what minute mark we’re in on that chapter), and I’ll just keep adjusting and saving camera views until you get it and can make better guesses.
